contents.command.continueInLocalClone: Clone Repository Locally dan buka on Desktop...
contents.command.continueInLocalClone.qualifiedNa: Continue Working in New Local Clone
contents.command.openWorktree: buka Worktree in saat ini jendela
contents.command.blameToggleStatusBarItem: Alihkan Git Blame bilah status Item
contents.config.path: Path dan filename of the git executable, e.g. `C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe` (jendela). This can also be an array of string values containing multiple paths to look up.
contents.config.autoRepositoryDetection: Mengonfigurasi when repositories should be automatically detected.
contents.config.autoRepositoryDetection.true: Scan untuk both subfolders of the saat ini dibuka folder dan parent folder of buka berkas.
contents.config.autoRepositoryDetection.subFolder: Scan untuk subfolders of the currently dibuka folder.
contents.config.autoRepositoryDetection.openEdito: Scan untuk parent folder of buka berkas.
contents.config.autofetch: Saat set to true, commits will automatically be fetched dari the bawaan remote of the saat ini Git repository. pengaturan to `all` will fetch dari all remotes.
contents.config.autofetchPeriod: Duration in seconds between each automatic git fetch, when `#git.autofetch#` is diaktifkan.
contents.config.confirmCommittedDelete: Confirm before menghapus committed berkas dengan Git.
contents.config.checkoutType: Mengontrol what type of Git refs are listed when berjalan `Checkout to...`.
contents.config.defaultBranchName: The name of the bawaan branch (example: main, trunk, development) when initializing a new Git repository. When set to empty, the bawaan branch name dikonfigurasi in Git will be used. **Note:** Requires Git version `2.28.0` atau later.
contents.config.branchPrefix: Prefix used when membuat a new branch.
contents.config.branchProtection: Daftar protected branches. secara bawaan, a prompt is ditampilkan before changes are committed to a protected branch. The prompt can be controlled using the `#git.branchProtectionPrompt#`  pengaturan.
contents.config.branchProtectionPrompt: Mengontrol apakah a prompt is being ditampilkan before changes are committed to a protected branch.
contents.config.branchProtectionPrompt.alwaysComm: Always commit changes to the protected branch.
Always commit changes to a new branch.
contents.config.branchProtectionPrompt.alwaysProm: Always prompt before changes are committed to a protected branch.
contents.config.branchRandomNameDictionary: Daftar dictionaries used untuk the randomly generated branch name. Each value represents the dictionary used to generate the segment of the branch name. Supported dictionaries: `adjectives`, `animals`, `colors` dan `numbers`.
contents.config.branchRandomNameEnable: Mengontrol apakah a random name is generated when membuat a new branch.
contents.config.branchValidationRegex: A regular expression to validate new branch names.
contents.config.branchWhitespaceChar: The character to ganti whitespace in new branch names, dan to separate segments of a randomly generated branch name.
contents.config.ignoreMissingGitWarning: Ignores the warning when Git is missing.
contents.config.ignoreWindowsGit27Warning: Ignores the warning when Git 2.25 - 2.26 is terpasang on jendela.
contents.config.ignoreLimitWarning: Ignores the warning when there are too many changes in a repository.
contents.config.ignoreRebaseWarning: Ignores the warning when it looks like the branch might have been rebased when pulling.
contents.config.defaultCloneDirectory: The bawaan location to clone a Git repository. Also used as the root folder untuk repositories cloned oleh remote clients when this machine is shared as a GitHub environment, unless chat.agentHost.defaultCloneDirectory is set. Remote clones are placed in <root>/<owner>/<repository>.
contents.config.useEditorAsCommitInput: Mengontrol apakah a full text editor will be used to author commit messages, whenever no message is provided in the commit input box.
contents.config.verboseCommit: Aktifkan verbose keluaran when `#git.useEditorAsCommitInput#` is diaktifkan.
contents.config.enableSmartCommit: Commit all changes when there are no staged changes.
contents.config.smartCommitChanges: Control which changes are automatically staged oleh Smart Commit.
contents.config.suggestSmartCommit: Suggests to aktifkan smart commit (commit all changes when there are no staged changes).
contents.config.enableCommitSigning: Mengaktifkan commit signing dengan GPG, X.509, atau SSH.
contents.config.discardAllScope: Mengontrol what changes are dibuang oleh the `Discard all changes` command. `all` discards all changes. `tracked` discards only tracked berkas. `prompt` shows a prompt dialog every time the action is jalankan.
contents.config.decorations.enabled: Mengontrol apakah Git contributes colors dan badges to the Explorer dan the buka editor tampilan.
contents.config.enableStatusBarSync: Mengontrol apakah the Git Sync command appears in the bilah status.
contents.config.followTagsWhenSync: Push all annotated tags when berjalan the sync command.
contents.config.replaceTagsWhenPull: Automatically ganti the local tags dengan the remote tags in case of a conflict when berjalan the pull command.
contents.config.promptToSaveFilesBeforeStash: Mengontrol apakah Git should check untuk unsaved berkas before stashing changes.
contents.config.promptToSaveFilesBeforeStash.stag: Check only untuk unsaved staged berkas.
contents.config.promptToSaveFilesBeforeCommit: Mengontrol apakah Git should check untuk unsaved berkas before committing.
contents.config.promptToSaveFilesBeforeCommit.sta: Check only untuk unsaved staged berkas.
contents.config.postCommitCommand: jalankan a git command after a successful commit.
contents.config.postCommitCommand.none: Don't jalankan any command after a commit.
contents.config.postCommitCommand.push: jalankan 'git push' after a successful commit.
contents.config.postCommitCommand.sync: jalankan 'git pull' dan 'git push' after a successful commit.
contents.config.rememberPostCommitCommand: Remember the last git command that ran after a commit.
contents.config.openAfterClone: Mengontrol apakah to buka a repository automatically after cloning.
contents.config.openAfterClone.always: Always buka in saat ini jendela.
contents.config.openAfterClone.alwaysNewWindow: Always buka in a new jendela.
contents.config.openAfterClone.whenNoFolderOpen: Only buka in saat ini jendela when no folder is dibuka.
contents.config.showInlineOpenFileAction: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan an inline buka berkas action in the Git changes tampilan.
contents.config.showPushSuccessNotification: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan a notification when a push is successful.
contents.config.inputValidation: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan commit message input validation diagnostics.
contents.config.inputValidationLength: Mengontrol commit message length threshold untuk menampilkan a warning.
contents.config.inputValidationSubjectLength: Mengontrol commit message subject length threshold untuk menampilkan a warning. Unset it to inherit the value of `#git.inputValidationLength#`.
contents.config.detectSubmodules: Mengontrol apakah to automatically detect Git submodules.
contents.config.detectSubmodulesLimit: Mengontrol limit of Git submodules detected.
contents.config.detectWorktrees: Mengontrol apakah to automatically detect Git worktrees.
contents.config.detectWorktreesLimit: Mengontrol limit of Git worktrees detected.
contents.config.worktreeIncludeFiles: Konfigurasikan patterns, using `.gitignore` syntax, untuk berkas dan folder that are included when membuat a new worktree. Only berkas dan folder that match the patterns dan are ignored oleh git (untuk example, listed in `.gitignore`) will be disalin to the newly dibuat worktree.
contents.config.worktreeSymlinkFolders: Konfigurasikan patterns, using `.gitignore` syntax, untuk folder to symlink dari the saat ini checkout ke newly dibuat worktrees. Only folder that match the patterns dan are ignored oleh git (untuk example, listed in `.gitignore`) will be symlinked. Changes made through a symlink affect the folder in the saat ini checkout.
contents.config.alwaysShowStagedChangesResourceGr: Always tampilkan the Staged Changes resource grup.
contents.config.alwaysSignOff: Mengontrol signoff flag untuk all commits.
contents.config.addAICoAuthor: Mengontrol apakah a 'Co-authored-oleh' trailer is automatically added to the commit message when AI-generated code is included in the commit.
contents.config.addAICoAuthor.off: Never add the AI co-author trailer.
contents.config.addAICoAuthor.chatAndAgent: Add the AI co-author trailer when code dari chat atau agen edits is included.
contents.config.addAICoAuthor.all: Add the AI co-author trailer when any AI-generated code is included, such as inline completions, chat, atau agen edits.
contents.config.ignoreSubmodules: Ignore modifications to submodules in the berkas tree.
contents.config.scanRepositories: Daftar paths to cari untuk Git repositories in.
contents.config.commandsToLog: Daftar git commands (ex: commit, push) that would have their `stdout` logged to the [git output](command:git.showOutput). If the git command has a client-side kait dikonfigurasi, the client-side kait's `stdout` will also be logged to the [git output](command:git.showOutput).
contents.config.showProgress: Mengontrol apakah Git actions should tampilkan progress.
contents.config.rebaseWhenSync: Force Git to use rebase when berjalan the sync command.
contents.config.confirmEmptyCommits: Always confirm the creation of empty commits untuk the 'Git: Commit Empty' command.
contents.config.fetchOnPull: Saat diaktifkan, fetch all branches when pulling. Otherwise, fetch just the saat ini one.
contents.config.pullBeforeCheckout: Mengontrol apakah a branch that does not have outgoing commits is fast-forwarded before it is checked out.
contents.config.autoStash: Stash any changes before pulling dan restore them after successful pull.
contents.config.allowForcePush: Mengontrol apakah force push (dengan atau tanpa lease) is diaktifkan.
contents.config.useForcePushWithLease: Mengontrol apakah force pushing uses the safer force-dengan-lease variant.
contents.config.useForcePushIfIncludes: Mengontrol apakah force pushing uses the safer force-if-includes variant. Note: This pengaturan requires the `#git.useForcePushWithLease#` pengaturan to be diaktifkan, dan Git version `2.30.0` atau later.
contents.config.confirmForcePush: Mengontrol apakah to ask untuk confirmation before force-pushing.
contents.config.allowNoVerifyCommit: Mengontrol apakah commits tanpa berjalan pre-commit dan commit-msg kait are allowed.
contents.config.confirmNoVerifyCommit: Mengontrol apakah to ask untuk confirmation before committing tanpa verification.
contents.config.closeDiffOnOperation: Mengontrol apakah the diff editor should be automatically ditutup when changes are stashed, committed, dibuang, staged, atau unstaged.
contents.config.openDiffOnClick: Mengontrol apakah the diff editor should be dibuka when clicking a change. Otherwise the regular editor will be dibuka.
contents.config.supportCancellation: Mengontrol apakah a notification comes up when berjalan the Sync action, which allows the user to batalkan the operation.
contents.config.untrackedChanges.mixed: All changes, tracked dan untracked, appear together dan behave equally.
contents.config.untrackedChanges.separate: Untracked changes appear separately in the Source Control tampilan. They are also excluded dari several actions.
contents.config.untrackedChanges.hidden: Untracked changes are tersembunyi dan excluded dari several actions.
contents.config.requireGitUserConfig: Mengontrol apakah to require explicit Git user configuration atau allow Git to guess if missing.
contents.config.showCommitInput: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan the commit input in the Git source control panel.
contents.config.terminalAuthentication: Mengontrol apakah to aktifkan VS Code to be the authentication handler untuk Git processes spawned in the Integrated terminal. Note: Terminals need to be dimulai ulang to pick up a change in this pengaturan.
contents.config.terminalGitEditor: Mengontrol apakah to aktifkan VS Code to be the Git editor untuk Git processes spawned in the integrated terminal. Note: Terminals need to be dimulai ulang to pick up a change in this pengaturan.
contents.config.timeline.showAuthor: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan the commit author in the Timeline tampilan.
contents.config.timeline.showUncommitted: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan uncommitted changes in the Timeline tampilan.
contents.config.timeline.date: Mengontrol which date to use untuk items in the Timeline tampilan.
contents.config.useCommitInputAsStashMessage: Mengontrol apakah to use the message dari the commit input box as the bawaan stash message.
contents.config.showActionButton: Mengontrol apakah an action button is ditampilkan in the Source Control tampilan.
contents.config.showActionButton.commit: tampilkan an action button to commit changes when the local branch has modified berkas ready to be committed.
contents.config.showActionButton.publish: tampilkan an action button to publish the local branch when it does not have a tracking remote branch.
contents.config.showActionButton.sync: tampilkan an action button to synchronize changes when the local branch is either ahead atau behind the remote branch.
contents.config.statusLimit: Mengontrol bagaimana to limit the number of changes that can be parsed dari Git status command. Can be set to 0 untuk no limit.
contents.config.experimental.installGuide: Experimental improvements untuk the Git setup flow.
contents.config.repositoryScanIgnoredFolders: Daftar folder that are ignored while scanning untuk Git repositories when `#git.autoRepositoryDetection#` is set to `true` atau `subFolders`.
contents.config.repositoryScanMaxDepth: Mengontrol depth used when scanning ruang kerja folder untuk Git repositories when `#git.autoRepositoryDetection#` is set to `true` atau `subFolders`. Can be set to `-1` untuk no limit.
contents.config.useIntegratedAskPass: Mengontrol apakah GIT_ASKPASS should be overwritten to use the integrated version.
contents.config.mergeEditor: buka the merge editor untuk berkas that are currently under conflict.
contents.config.optimisticUpdate: Mengontrol apakah to optimistically perbarui the state of the Source Control tampilan after berjalan git commands.
contents.config.openRepositoryInParentFolders: Control whether a repository in parent folder of ruang kerja atau buka berkas should be dibuka.
contents.config.openRepositoryInParentFolders.alw: Always buka a repository in parent folder of ruang kerja atau buka berkas.
contents.config.openRepositoryInParentFolders.nev: Never buka a repository in parent folder of ruang kerja atau buka berkas.
contents.config.openRepositoryInParentFolders.pro: Prompt before membuka a repository the parent folder of ruang kerja atau buka berkas.
contents.config.publishBeforeContinueOn: Mengontrol apakah to publish unpublished Git state when using Continue Working On dari a Git repository.
contents.config.publishBeforeContinueOn.always: Always publish unpublished Git state when using Continue Working On dari a Git repository
contents.config.publishBeforeContinueOn.never: Never publish unpublished Git state when using Continue Working On dari a Git repository
contents.config.publishBeforeContinueOn.prompt: Prompt to publish unpublished Git state when using Continue Working On dari a Git repository
contents.config.similarityThreshold: Mengontrol threshold of the similarity index (the amount of additions/deletions compared to the berkas's size) untuk changes in a pair of added/dihapus berkas to be considered a ganti nama. **Note:** Requires Git version `2.18.0` atau later.
contents.config.blameEditorDecoration.enabled: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan blame information in the editor using editor decorations.
contents.config.blameEditorDecoration.template:
Template untuk the blame information editor decoration. Supported variables:

* `hash`: Commit hash

* `hashShort`: First N characters of the commit hash according to `#git.commitShortHashLength#`

* `subject`: First line of the commit message

* `authorName`: Author name

* `authorEmail`: Author email

* `authorDate`: Author date

* `authorDateAgo`: Time difference between now dan the author date
contents.config.blameEditorDecoration.disableHove: Mengontrol apakah to nonaktifkan the blame information editor decoration hover.
contents.config.blameStatusBarItem.enabled: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan blame information in the bilah status.
contents.config.blameStatusBarItem.template:
Template untuk the blame information bilah status item. Supported variables:

* `hash`: Commit hash

* `hashShort`: First N characters of the commit hash according to `#git.commitShortHashLength#`

* `subject`: First line of the commit message

* `authorName`: Author name

* `authorEmail`: Author email

* `authorDate`: Author date

* `authorDateAgo`: Time difference between now dan the author date
contents.config.blameIgnoreWhitespace: Mengontrol apakah to ignore whitespace changes when computing blame information.
contents.config.commitShortHashLength: Mengontrol length of the commit short hash.
contents.config.diagnosticsCommitHook.enabled: Mengontrol apakah to check untuk unresolved diagnostics before committing.
contents.config.diagnosticsCommitHook.sources: Mengontrol list of sources (**Item**) dan the minimum severity (**Value**) to be considered before committing. **Note:** To ignore diagnostics dari a particular source, add the source to the list dan set the minimum severity to `none`.
contents.config.discardUntrackedChangesToTrash: Mengontrol apakah membuang untracked changes moves the berkas(s) to the Recycle Bin (jendela), Trash (macOS, Linux) instead of menghapus them permanently. **Note:** This pengaturan has no effect when connected to a remote atau when berjalan in Linux as a snap package.
contents.config.showReferenceDetails: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan the details of the last commit untuk Git refs in the checkout, branch, dan tag pickers.
contents.colors.stageModified: Warna untuk modified resources which have been staged.
contents.colors.stageDeleted: Warna untuk dihapus resources which have been staged.
contents.colors.renamed: Warna untuk diganti nama atau disalin resources.
contents.colors.incomingRenamed: Warna untuk diganti nama incoming resource.

contents.view.workbench.scm.empty:
In order to use Git features, you can buka a folder containing a Git repository atau clone dari a URL.

contents.view.workbench.scm.folder:
The folder currently buka doesn't have a Git repository. You can initialize a repository which will aktifkan source control features powered oleh Git.
[Initialize Repository](command:git.init?__TOK_0__true__TOK_1__)

contents.view.workbench.scm.workspace:

[Initialize Repository](command:git.init)
To learn more about how to use Git dan source control in VS Code [read our docs](https://aka.ms/vscode-scm).
contents.view.workbench.scm.emptyWorkspace:

[Add Folder to Workspace](command:workbench.action.addRootFolder)
